page.overview:
What is Pumpkin Pie?

Pumpkin pie is a food item that can be eaten by the player.

Apprentice-level farmer villagers have a 50% or chance to sell 4 pumpkin pies for an emerald as part of their trades.

To eat pumpkin pie, press and hold while it is selected in the hotbar. Eating one restores hunger and 4.8 saturation.

Placing pumpkin pie into a composter raises the compost level by 1.
